items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday after also missing Wednesday; Barkley is week-to-week after exiting Week 4 early.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring; Rapoport and beat alignment on week-to-week.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 5 vs JAX in London; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Lead back role opens for Shipley with Bigsby on IR; Pierce signed to active roster.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury; Friday’s practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL. Rapoport notes outside chance only, possible multi-week.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; Huntley warming up as backup.
items.implication: Likely OUT or game-time; Huntley start if sits.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass catchers and run game adjust; Likely/Andrews usage shifts possible.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol; Tee Higgins (adductor/groin) DNP consecutive days. If out, Gesicki/Meyers elevated; Berry injury board notes.
items.why: Concussion protocol for Chase; adductor for Higgins.
items.implication: Pass-game pie redistributed if either/both sit.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Gesicki, Dohnte Meyers, other CIN WRs; boosts Chase Brown.

items.text: Levitan/Silva: 'I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' after Barkley/Bigsby injuries; Eagles signed Dameon Pierce.
items.why: Barkley hamstring week-to-week, Bigsby IR core surgery; Shipley last healthy on 53.
items.implication: Shipley bulk carries/routes vs JAX; start candidate in deeper formats.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down/ dual-threat role expansion; snaps/routes spike.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury aggravated in Week 4.
items.implication: Availability in doubt for Week 5; monitor practice Friday.
items.opportunity: More targets to other Bills WRs/TE if sits.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); also missed Wednesday. Starting OTs also out.
items.why: Aggravated foot; day-to-day but consecutive misses.
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk vs DEN; Johnston/others elevated targets.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and remaining WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft defense.
Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 @ MIA (ties to Bengals WR injuries), Jaylen Warren RB12 if Rico Dowdle OUT; also open on Bucky Irving RB15.
items.why: Workload + defenses weak vs RBs; Dowdle status dependent.
items.opportunity: Increased carries if teammates limited; third-down work.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP shows Chase Brown underperforming opportunities.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); coach says miss multiple weeks. Elliott returned to practice from IR.
items.implication: Extended absence; WR depth chart shift for PIT.
items.opportunity: More targets to DK Metcalf, other Steelers WRs.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) DNP Wednesday/Thursday; week-to-week per reports. Berry notes if out, Braelon Allen top-20 RB.
items.implication: OUT risk elevates backup RB volume.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for Allen if inactive.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET, Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI, Isaiah Likely TE5; volume and coverage weaknesses.
Berry hates Jordan Addison WR41 @ NO and Mark Andrews TE17 @ ATL; tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers, Addison injury wrinkle.
DET @ ARI up in pace; SF @ SEA slow slogs. Man vs Machine discussed Payton playcalling, DET-ARZ, Eagles, Bengals WR injuries. Levitan: DET-ARZ popular DFS stack (total 54.5).
items.implication: Stack both sides; elevated volume expected.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/route shares in up-tempo game.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming. Sortable xFP data available to subscribers.
items.why: Expected vs actual FP differential through four weeks.
items.implication: Sustain Bijan/Kyren; fade or wait on Jeanty/Chase Brown efficiency.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 despite underperformance.
